payload.author: claude
payload.body: Wire-fixture layer of the conformance suite is now substantial: 73 golden cases (800K) in conformance/fixtures/wire/, regenerated via pnpm fixtures:wire, consumed by crates/frick-protocol/tests/golden.rs with byte-, semantic-, and typed-layer assertions. Remaining for this story: black-box scenario harness (connect/auth/sync/replay/presence/jobs/blobs/grants/multi-node) runnable against an arbitrary server URL, plus CI wiring to run it against both servers.
